name: Paweł Kajanek
summary: I'm a frontend developer with 4+ years of experience who is passionate about creating useful tools. Through my career I developed strong analytical skills and my appetite for learning new technologies has only grown. That transfers to my private life, as in my free time I enjoy solving puzzles and building fullstack apps for my own daily usage. In the future I aim to become more of a fullstack developer professionally as well.

work.description: During my work with STX Next I've been involved in several projects for international clients. Most of them required me to work as a solo frontend developer with a broad spectrum of responsibilities spanning from refining tasks and creating roadmaps, to developing and debugging the application.
responsibilities: Reviewing issues and recommending possible solutions
Assessing workload and creating development plans
Creating various widgets for data display, preference customization and query applying, that match designs
Migrating widgets from Backbone.js to React.js
Creating automated tests for UI components
Introducing a new library and adapting its components in an existing project
Identifying areas for improvements and preforming app-wide refactors

work.description: At ULAN Software I've been working on a project called BOWWE, which is a tool for creating professional business sites, resumes and portfolios. The app uses drag-and-drop interface and contains a wide range of configurable widgets, making it beginner friendly. Additionally it takes care of responsiveness, translations, SEO and has marketing tool integrations.
responsibilities: Creating "User Dashboard" page, which displayed user's social profile and portfolio
Writing minor API endpoints providing data for "User Dashboard" components
Migrating "Pricing" page from Vanilla to Vue
Developing the product with an agile methodology
